invariants.rationale: stage is used throughout the method and methods are called on it, so it must be non-null at method exit.
this SelectBox is added as an actor to the stage at the start of show(Stage), so it should be present in stage's actors at method exit.
The method sets this SelectBox as scroll focus before method exit.
At the end of the method, list.setTouchable(Touchable.enabled) is called, making list touchable at exit.
list.selection.set(selectBox.getSelected()) is explicitly set near the end, matching the selected value.
